name: Buscaline
summary: Buscaline (B), also known as 4-butoxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the derivative of mescaline in which the methoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a butoxy group.

pharmacology.text: The effects of buscaline have been reported to include a slight change from baseline, no noticeable visual or auditory effects, uninteresting mental effects, body load, more bodily effects than mental effects, brief heart arrhythmia, stomach discomfort, light diarrhea, cold feet, and slight uncomfortableness.

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical with no medical use, known mainly from Alexander Shulgin's work on mescaline analogues.
uses.zh: 它是罕見的研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，主要見於 Alexander Shulgin 對麥斯卡林類似物的研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是罕见的研究化学品，没有医疗用途，主要见于 Alexander Shulgin 对麦斯卡林类似物的研究。

sideEffects.en: Reports in people are few. They describe little change in perception but a noticeable physical heaviness, along with brief changes in hearing. Its risks are otherwise unknown.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它在人體的回報很少。這些回報描述知覺變化不大，但身體明顯沉重，並有短暫的聽覺改變。除此之外，它的風險並不清楚。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它在人体的回报很少。这些回报描述知觉变化不大，但身体明显沉重，并有短暂的听觉改变。除此之外，它的风险并不清楚。

fact.en: It is mescaline with a butyl chain in place of the middle methyl group. In the scaline family, lengthening that chain tends to flatten the effect, and reports of buscaline describe very little happening.
fact.zh: Buscaline 是把麥斯卡林中間的甲基換成丁基鏈的產物。在 scaline 家族中，延長這條鏈往往會減弱作用，而關於 buscaline 的回報也形容幾乎沒什麼感覺。
fact.zhHans: Buscaline 是把麦斯卡林中间的甲基换成丁基链的产物。在 scaline 家族中，延长这条链往往会减弱作用，而关于 buscaline 的回报也形容几乎没什么感觉。
